environment.description: Same Quarkus function deployed behind an internal NLB (Network Load Balancer) in a private VPC subnet (10.128.0.0/16). The NLB target group has a security group with inbound rules restricted to three CIDR blocks: 10.2.4.0/24 (API gateway fleet), 10.2.5.0/24 (service mesh sidecar proxies), and 172.16.0.0/20 (monitoring subnet). There is no internet-facing ingress path. The upstream API gateway (Apigee Edge, running in 10.2.4.0/24) performs its own RS256-only JWT validation before forwarding requests, stripping and re-signing tokens with a separate internal signing key. VPC flow logs are enabled with reject-logging to CloudWatch. The NLB has no public DNS record and is not associated with any internet gateway or NAT gateway for inbound traffic.

config.upstream_gateway: Apigee Edge with RS256-only JWT policy (OAuthV2 + VerifyJWT with algorithm constraint)
